blocks.prompt: 6 Find \(n\) so that \(\frac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^{n} + b^{n}}\) may be H.M. between \(a\) and \(b\).
blocks.explanation:
The given fraction must equal the H.M. \(\frac{2ab}{a + b}\) for all \(a \ne b\).
The unknown \(n\) is in the powers.
Plan: equate, cross-multiply, factor, and use \(a \ne b\).
steps:
Given: \(\frac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^{n} + b^{n}}\) is the H.M. of \(a\) and \(b\) (\(a \ne b\)).
To find: \(n\).
Method: Set the fraction equal to \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\) and simplify until \(n\) can be read off.

Set up the equation
\[\dfrac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^{n} + b^{n}} = \dfrac{2ab}{a + b}\]
Why: "May be H.M." means it equals the H.M. formula.

Cross-multiply
\[(a^{n+1} + b^{n+1})(a + b)\]
\[= 2ab(a^{n} + b^{n})\]
Why: Clear both denominators.

Expand both sides
\[a^{n+2} + a^{n+1}b + ab^{n+1} + b^{n+2}\]
\[= 2a^{n+1}b + 2ab^{n+1}\]
Why: Laws of indices: \(a^{n+1} \cdot a = a^{n+2}\) and \(ab \cdot a^{n} = a^{n+1}b\).

Bring everything to one side
\[a^{n+2} - a^{n+1}b - ab^{n+1} + b^{n+2} = 0\]
Why: Subtract the right side; \(a^{n+1}b - 2a^{n+1}b = -a^{n+1}b\), and the same for \(ab^{n+1}\).

Factor by grouping
\[a^{n+1}(a - b) - b^{n+1}(a - b) = 0\]
\[(a - b)(a^{n+1} - b^{n+1}) = 0\]
Why: Take \(a^{n+1}\) common from the first two terms and \(-b^{n+1}\) from the last two.

Use \(a \ne b\)
\[a^{n+1} - b^{n+1} = 0\]
\[\left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^{n+1} = 1 = \left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^{0}\]
\[n + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow n = -1\]
Why: \(a - b \ne 0\), so the other factor is 0. A power of \(\frac{a}{b} \ne 1\) can equal 1 only when the exponent is 0.

Check
\[n = -1: \; \dfrac{a^{0} + b^{0}}{a^{-1} + b^{-1}} = \dfrac{2}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}}\]
\[= \dfrac{2}{\frac{a + b}{ab}} = \dfrac{2ab}{a + b} \;\checkmark\]
Agrees with the answer key.
